# AI Dev Workspace — expanded context

> Shared Markdown task memory for developers who switch between Claude Code and Codex. Save decisions, next actions and dead ends in files you own; configured local hooks provide a task brief at session start. Install `pipx install ai-dev-workspace --pip-args='--pre'`, then run `ws start` in a Git repo to preview setup. Python 3.9+ CLI (`ws`) and local stdio MCP server; MIT licensed.

## Stable — published 0.1.0b5

- Local Markdown task records, explicit `ws remember`, `ws checkpoint` and `ws brief`.
- Seven core MCP tools by default; other tools remain callable by name.
- Claude Code and Codex have live checks on macOS. Cursor, Copilot and Gemini
  integrations are fixture-tested; Linux/Windows have CI, not live-client proof.
- Only saved information is remembered; automatic transcript capture is best-effort.
- The optional guards pack is a safety net, not a security boundary.

## Stable workflow — published 0.1.0b5

```sh
pipx install ai-dev-workspace --pip-args='--pre'
cd path/to/your/git-repo
ws start
ws remember "Prices are integer cents"
ws checkpoint --status in_progress --next "Add the rate-limit check"
ws brief
```

`ws start` lists its files and asks before applying repo-local setup. Private
memory lives outside the code repo; generated local wiring is Git-excluded.
Opening the repo in a configured client supplies the task brief. Rerun `ws start`
for setup status; `ws start --undo` removes unchanged files that setup owns and
keeps user edits for review. Do not commit private memory or local client config.

Memory uses no background model calls. A plain handoff file can be sufficient;
historical synthetic results are not a claim of general productivity gains.
See the released Measurements page for later runs and the plain-HANDOFF caveat.

## Preview installation — Claude Code plugin

With the CLI installed and `ws start` completed in the repo, run in Claude Code:

```text
/plugin marketplace add Alenroyfeild/ai-dev-workspace
/plugin install ai-dev-workspace@ai-dev-workspace
```

This is our GitHub marketplace, not Anthropic's official directory. The beta.5
plugin has a live Claude check; setup and duplicate-wiring limits are described
in the [plugin guide](https://github.com/Alenroyfeild/ai-dev-workspace/blob/main/docs/ADVANCED.md#claude-code-plugin-preview).
Team sharing is also preview: share only reviewed notes with a private team repo.

## Coming next (beta.6)

The linked dev guides and unreleased changes are source previews, not additional
features of the published 0.1.0b5 package. Antigravity hooks are fixture-tested,
without live Antigravity proof. New packaging search terms ship with the next release.

- [Share memory between Claude Code and Codex](https://github.com/Alenroyfeild/ai-dev-workspace/blob/dev/docs/guides/share-memory-claude-code-codex.md)
- [Keep decisions without a background AI](https://github.com/Alenroyfeild/ai-dev-workspace/blob/dev/docs/guides/keep-decisions-without-background-ai.md)
- [Stop retrying failed approaches](https://github.com/Alenroyfeild/ai-dev-workspace/blob/dev/docs/guides/stop-retrying-failed-approaches.md)
- [Unreleased fragments](https://github.com/Alenroyfeild/ai-dev-workspace/tree/dev/changelog.d)
